findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "planner" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: segment_esp, plan_from_list, get_diagnostic_playbook, plan_rotation, plan_verification_waterfall, find_tools, find_resources, read_resource, get_pricing · Private data: lookup_mx, segment_esp, plan_from_list, generate_dns_records · Public sink: check_domain_expiry, segment_esp, plan_from_list, plan_infrastructure, quote_inboxes, get_diagnostic_playbook, generate_dns_records, plan_rotation, plan_verification_waterfall, find_tools, find_resources, get_pricing · Destructive: get_diagnostic_playbook, plan_verification_waterfall.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: segment_esp, plan_from_list, get_diagnostic_playbook, plan_rotation, plan_verification_waterfall, find_tools, find_resources, read_resource, get_pricing · Private data: lookup_mx, segment_esp, plan_from_list, generate_dns_records · Public sink: check_domain_expiry, segment_esp, plan_from_list, plan_infrastructure, quote_inboxes, get_diagnostic_playbook, generate_dns_records, plan_rotation, plan_verification_waterfall, find_tools, find_resources, get_pricing · Destructive: get_diagnostic_playbook, plan_verification_waterfall

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
